name: Arborio Rice
siboNotes: Plain arborio rice is well-tolerated and provides easily digestible carbohydrates. Cook with garlic-infused oil instead of garlic for SIBO-friendly risotto.
preparationTips: Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Choose low-FODMAP broth or make your own with allowed vegetables
Add lactose-free parmesan or aged hard cheese for richness
Stir in low-FODMAP vegetables like spinach or bell peppers
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of carbohydrates for energy
Low in fat and naturally gluten-free
